content: Kain ve Avel
Murei ra, Adam yesuru azaawa tigheen ve Eva aapo. I ipoop naatu tamoot ve iwaat eeza Kain. Ve isaav ighe: “Maaron iuul ghau, tauta napoop natug tane.”
Tilepleep le murei ra, Eva ipoop Kain taazi Avel. Yesuru timin zolman, mako Avel iŋginŋgin sipsip, ve Kain ighamgham uraat pa uum.
Saawe ee, Kain igham aniiŋ anooŋa siriv tau ivot ila uum tooni na imin watooŋrau pa Yoova.
Ve Avel paam irav sipsip tooni natŋa aidabazŋa siriv, ve igham sirivu tau popoia kat na ila pa Yoova imin watooŋrau pani. Yoova loolo poia pa Avel tomania watooŋrau tooni.
Eemon Kain tomania watooŋrau tooni, ene Yoova irere pani. Tauta Kain aate yavyav kat le naagho isaghat.
Tauvene Yoova ighason Kain ighe: “Puughu mindai ta atem yavyav le naghom isaghat?

Isaav ighe yo ugham ŋgar duduuŋa, ene pale lolog poia payo ve tintinim. Eemon isaav ighe ugham ŋgar tau iduduuŋ mako, na uyamaan ghom. Pasaa, ŋgar saghati ileep ataman tsio aavo, ve isasaŋan ghom ighe igham ghom umin le. Tauvene yo aat uyooz ariaaŋ ve utatan ŋgar saghati tana izi.”
Murei ra Kain isaav pa taazi Avel ighe: “Ulam ituru tala talaghlaagh uum loolo.” Yesuru tila ta sewe, ra Kain iburig ve irav taazi Avel imaat.
Tauvene Yoova ighason Kain ighe: “Kain, tazim Avel ileep sindei?” Kain iyol aliiŋa ighe: “Yau nakankaan pani. Mindai, yau namin ŋginiiŋ to tazig?”
Ra Yoova isaav pani muul ighe: “Yo ugham ŋgar tane pasaa? Ulooŋ. Tazim siŋ tooni tau imaliŋ izi taan na, tauta iboboob izalam payau.
Yo urav tazim imaat, ve taan tane ighun siŋ tooni wa. Tauvene yau aat naghur pataŋani tane iŋarui ghom: Yo irau uleep muul izi taan tane mako.
Ve isaav ighe yo uvazogh aniiŋ izila taan to nugh ite paam, ene pale ughita anooŋa eta mako. Yo aat irau uleep tuŋia izi nugh eta mako. Pale uvalaghlaagh irau taan naol.”
Kain ilooŋ saveeŋ tane, ve isaav pa Yoova ighe: “Atuya to sosor tsiau tau yo ughuru payau, ene pataŋani kat. Irau nabaado mako.

Ughita. Aazne yo uziir ghau pa taan tane ve nala naleep soghan payo. Ve ughe yau irau naleep tuŋia izi nugh eta mako. Pale navalaghlaagh irau taan naol, ve ighe ŋeer eta indeeŋ ghau, i pale irav ghau namaat.”

Eemon Yoova iyol aliiŋa muul ighe: “Mako. Isaav ighe ŋeer eta irav ghom umaat, ene pale nayat ŋeer tana sosor tooni irau pai liim ve ru.” Ra Yoova ighur ilaal ee izaa to Kain. Leso tamtamon tighita ve tiravu sov.
Kain ipul Yoova, ve ilaagh ila ivot taan sirivu ee, eeza Nod, ve ileep ta sewe. Taan tawe igheen uum Eden ziige ila pa aaz izaa.
Kain paaghu tooni
Murei ra, Kain yesuru azaawa tigheen, ve livaa aapo ve ipoop naatu aidaaba, eeza Anok. Ra Kain igharaat nugh tiina ee, ve iwaat naatu Anok eeza pani.
Anok naatu Irad, Irad naatu Mehuyael, Mehuyael naatu Metusael, ve Metusael naatu Lamek.
Lamek ivai zilivaa ru. Ee eeza Ada, ve ite eeza Zila.
Lamek azaawa Ada ta ipoop Yabal. Yabal paaghu tooni, ene yes tau tilaghlaagh tomania ŋgai toozi, ve tilepleep ila balbaal tau tigharaata pa ŋgai uuli.
Yabal taazi, eeza Yubal. Paaghu tooni, ta tighagharaat mboi to vivuuŋ ve gabua siriv imin gita.
Lamek azaawa ite Zila ipoop Tuval-Kain. Tuval-Kain paaghu tooni, ta tighagharaat ain ve baras imin gabua siriv to uraat. Tuval-Kain liivu eeza Naama.
Saawe ee, Lamek isaav pa azauŋa ru ighe:

content.text: Yau Lamek azuwagŋa ta yamru. Aghur taliŋamim pa saveeŋ tsiau.
Ighe ŋeer eta irav ghau le siŋig izi, ene aat naravu imaat.
Ve isaav ighe ŋeer paaghu eta iposai paŋag, ene pale naravu imaat paam.
Alooŋ. Ighe tamtamon eta irav Kain imaat, ene pale tiyatu irau pai liim ve ru.

content: Eemon yau, isaav ighe tirav matin ghau, ene pale tiyatu irau pai tamoot tol saŋavul liim ve ru (77).”
Set ve Enos
Adam yesuru azaawa Eva tigheen muul, ve Eva aapo, ve ipoop tamoot ite. I iwaat eeza Set, ve isaav tauvene: “Kain irav taazi Avel gha imaat, tauta Maaron igham leg tamtamon ite tane, leso iyoli.”
Murei ra, Set yesuru azaawa tipoop tamoot ee, ve Set iwaat eeza Enos. Saawe tana, tamtamon tipaburigin ŋgar to suŋuuŋ pa Yoova.
